profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software Architect with strong background in software design, security, devops, and optimization. Extensive knowledge of the .NET platform and web technologies.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led the team owning payments and user management flows across a multi-brand, global food ordering platform, spanning both mobile apps and backend services.

Re-architected the payments system into a modular design, significantly improving fault isolation and reliability across diverse payment processor integrations used in different regions and brands.

Orchestrated the migration of a large monolithic GraphQL server to a modern Federated GraphQL architecture using Apollo Federation, enabling scalable development through multiple subgraphs and a centralized, managed gateway.

Drove substantial AWS cost optimizations by transitioning Lambda functions to Arm architecture, introducing TTL-based storage cleanup for DynamoDB, and writing a one-time job to purge stale records—resulting in notable storage and invocation cost reductions. Also enhanced CDN efficiency by fine-tuning CloudFront caching policies to boost cache hit ratios.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Terraform · NestJS · AWS Lambda

positions.title: Senior Software Architect
positions.description: Oversee architecture of carnival.com and supports scrum teams in accomplishing their goals. Assess emerging technologies and how they can improve our architecture to better serve the business. Identify and help solve common challenges by engineering teams. Bootstrap new engineering initiatives. Implement and maintain business features, help with code reviews, and troubleshoot production issues. Push forward the architecture towards more cloud native solutions: adoption of containers and Kubernetes, high quality continuous integration pipelines, great observability and monitoring. Serve as mentor to other engineers.

positions.title: Web Architect
positions.description: Led effort to modernize our tech stack. This included breaking apps into smaller services, rewriting ASP.NET apps to ASP.NET Core, standardizing in React as our frontend technology, improving our application configuration story with Spring Cloud Config Server, and using Redis more heavily as our distributed cache solution.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description: Worked on the backend and frontend of carnival.com expanding the suite of online features offered to guests. Created lots of highly interactive experiences with the technologies of the moment: jQuery, Backbone, KnockoutJS, and AngularJS.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Automation of many City of Miami services to make them available to the citizenry via a unified Portal system. Using the latest Microsoft and web technologies.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software design and development of .NET systems using the latest Microsoft technologies. Successfully developed software for Dole Food Company, The Coca-Cola Company, and IBM.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Maintained .NET system serving more than 100 hospitals nationwide in a multi-tenant environment. Responsibilities ranged from SQL Server query optimization, to refinement of business processes and UI enhancements in the web portal.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Created the initial prototype user interface of the www.patentssearcher.com system. Used Linux, Java, JSP, Tomcat, jQuery, shell scripting.

publications.title: PatentsSearcher: A Novel Portal to Search and Explore Patents
publications.publisher: 3rd International Workshop on Patent Information Retrieval PaIR 2010, at ACM CIKM 2010. · Jan 1, 2010
